topic: Bounded chunked transport and independent replay of native root proofs
statement: Implementation and selected-source execution evidence only; no profile, campaign, workstream gate or claim tier is promoted.
invariants: Opaque byte staging cannot authorize a mathematical claim.
Kind-bound full content IDs and content/index-bound chunk digests are checked before independent replay.
Append refuses without changing the retained prefix; exact old-index retries compare bytes and consume cumulative resources.
Receiving sources, ordered typed axes, context, and complete-isolation domain are independently bound.
Canonical decoding and mathematical replay use the protected verifier compute pool; transport uses ordinary compute.
Accepted roots and complete-isolation child handles publish only after all response/collision/resource admission succeeds.
Explicit release frees a resident slot without refunding spent resources.
